items.title: Next ECB chief favors tokenized bank deposits over stablecoins and bitcoin
items.summary: Pablo Hernández de Cos, chosen to succeed Christine Lagarde, favors blockchain-based banking and has warned against private digital currencies and banks holding bitcoin.

items.title: Injective asks SEC to allow order books for tokenized stock trading
items.summary: The regulator's rules favor one type of blockchain trading system, leaving platforms built on Injective out, the developer said. It wants the SEC to open stock trading to order-book systems.

items.title: Brazil’s stock exchange teams up with major banks to launch real-pegged stablecoin
items.summary: Banco B3 will issue the token, backed one-to-one by reais, and other financial institutions can join from launch.

items.title: Tether can freeze stolen crypto in minutes. Getting it back can take years.
items.summary: Tether says it has returned $1.28 billion in frozen USDT, but victims can wait years to recover their money and face fees of up to 20%.

items.title: Bitcoin tops $61,000 as Nasdaq futures extend Wednesday’s rebound
items.summary: U.S. equity futures extended Wednesday’s rebound after markets closed for Thanksgiving, with AI infrastructure stocks leading premarket gains.

items.title: Monero suffers biggest single-day slide in over 5 months. Here’s why
items.summary: Monero (XMR) crashed over 11% on Thursday, its biggest drop since early June. Back-to-back exchange delistings seem to have catalyzed the price slide.

items.title: Ripple's lending plan moves closer to tapping XRP Ledger's $800 million in stablecoins
items.summary: The vaults that would hold lenders' money are on track to switch on Dec. 9. The loan system that draws from them still needs one more validator to start its own two-week clock.

items.title: Binance says customer withdrawals are fully restored, four weeks after the $6.3 billion hack
items.summary: Binance says it has fully lifted withdrawal suspensions imposed after October’s $6.3 billion hack, though a small number of networks remain paused for unrelated maintenance.

items.title: Ethereum's much-awaited Glamsterdam upgrade cleared for December test. Here's what to know
items.summary: Developers have agreed to keep the planned storage charges despite concerns about some existing smart contracts, ending seven weeks of delays to the next major test.

items.title: A tiny payment can expose the IP address behind a bitcoin wallet, developer finds
items.summary: A Bitcoin Core contributor found that the wallet's habit of resending stuck payments lets anyone link an address to the computer watching it, for under 35 cents.

items.title: Bitcoin supply metric hits 11-year low as new ‘capitulation’ signal arrives
items.summary: The seven-day moving average of Bitcoin’s supply profit/loss ratio hit an 11-year low as BTC price losses month-to-date remain near 20%.

items.title: Bluefin to shut down perps, refocus on spot trading and tokenized RWAs
items.summary: Bluefin will close its perps platform on Dec. 4, exiting a shrinking Sui market where it once handled over $500 million in daily trades.

items.title: ESMA to overhaul EU’s MiCA crypto register in 2027
items.summary: ESMA’s new MiCA register will replace manual reporting and introduce automated data checks and a version history for crypto white papers.

items.title: New York AG secures $1.37B court judgment against NovaTech founders
items.summary: The judgment follows an August 2025 default ruling against the founders over a Ponzi scheme that targeted Haitian and other immigrant communities.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Japan’s crypto security group taps SEAL to speed up hack response
items.summary: The partnership comes weeks after a third-party data breach exposed hundreds of thousands of customer email addresses belonging to two Japanese crypto exchanges.

items.title: Ethereum devs set Glamsterdam’s Hoodi rollout for mid-December after delays
items.summary: Glamsterdam’s Hoodi upgrade was delayed in October after concerns that changes to gas pricing could break some existing smart contracts.

items.title: AI is driving a flood of crypto bug reports. Now it’s helping sort them
items.summary: Bug bounty platform HackerOne said it’s increasing its triage throughput with AI agents after a record quarter of reports in the third quarter.

items.title: Privacy coins face diverging fortunes as KuCoin moves to drop Monero
items.summary: As KuCoin joins exchanges dropping Monero ahead of new EU restrictions, Grayscale argues that Zcash’s privacy design sets it apart.

items.title: ‘Very racist’ Netflix SBF series, BitMart’s $319M shortfall: Asia Express
items.summary: Netflix’s The Altruist has been slammed for its ‘very racist’ portrayal of CZ. BitMart reportedly has a $319.5 million shortfall and just $1.9M in liquid assets.

items.title: Kalshi Courts Small Businesses With 'Microinsurance' as State Crackdowns Bite
items.summary: Kalshi says about 500 businesses have used it to hedge risks such as tariffs and bad weather, as legal fights weigh on its sports markets.

items.title: Ethereum Sets December 15 Date for Delayed Glamsterdam Testnet Upgrade
items.summary: Core developers will ship Glamsterdam's contested gas changes unaltered, after security concerns halted the Hoodi fork in October.

items.title: Vibecoded GTA 6 PC Ports Are Now Rendering In-Game Graphics Despite Take-Two Crackdown
items.summary: Some unofficial ports now hit around 20 frames per second, as developers move their work into private communities to dodge takedowns.

items.title: What Is Self-Custody? How to Hold Your Own Crypto Keys
items.summary: Self-custody means holding your own crypto instead of trusting an exchange. Here's how it works, the wallets involved and the risks.

items.title: Before the Sell-Off, AI Stocks Showed Dot-Com-Level Bubble Signals: Study
items.summary: A study of 170 years of financial journalism suggests AI stocks rivaled dot-com bubble levels, but estimates vary.

items.title: Bitcoin Holds Above $60K as Death Cross Clouds Thanksgiving Recovery
items.summary: Bitcoin and major altcoins rose slightly on Thanksgiving, but a bearish death cross suggests crypto remains weaker than stocks.

items.title: Spain Lets Its Financial Intelligence Unit Freeze Crypto Accounts Without a Court Order
items.summary: Sepblac can now suspend crypto, bank and payment accounts for up to five working days, with courts deciding on any extension.

items.title: OpenAI Fixes ChatGPT Billing Error, Promises to Make it 40% Worse
items.summary: OpenAI says a billing mistake made its new AI models cheaper to use than intended. Subscribers will now burn through their allowances faster, but get a free one-time usage reset.

items.title: Elon Musk Says ‘Multiplanetary’ SpaceX Could Be Worth $118 Quintillion. Yes, Quintillion
items.summary: The SpaceX founder claims the firm could one day be worth a million times the global economy, as he pledges free shares to American children.

items.title: Cournot Raises $5M to Build AI-Native Oracle for Verifiable Intelligence
items.summary: The startup uses AI to interpret real-world events for onchain apps and agents, recording evidence and reasoning so outcomes can be audited.
